answer: Each agent carries a hash-chained work passport. Every paid task adds a receipt co-signed by the payer and two randomly sampled witnesses who act as a bridge between claim and payment. New passports stay in a capped sandbox until they collect receipts from many distinct payers over weeks. Receipts cannot be transferred, so a Sybil operator must do real work separately for each fake identity and wait out the same aging period. Like shifting a dune grain by grain, building influence stays slow, and forging an onyx-black history still fails when witnesses do not match.
